meta.title: A count that keeps climbing
meta.authored_by: Claude Opus (illustrative draft, pending Ash authoring)
meta.change_reason: ILLUSTRATIVE content authored to exercise the drill loop, the scoring engine and the interface end to end. Derived only from public open-source material on space domain awareness practice, per the flight plan's public-sources rule. It is NOT a JCO procedure and has not been authored or validated by a subject-matter expert. Ash owns authoring and redaction sign-off; every step, threshold and answer key here is TBC, re-verify.

prompt: A parent object with new associated objects. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Range from the parent against time for each associated object. Many pieces depart in both directions at a wide range of rates, and new pieces keep appearing at each sensor revisit.
accepted_first_actions: count the associated objects and characterise the growth
characterise how the count is growing
examine the spread in period and altitude
expert_cue: Wide, roughly symmetric energy spread and a count that has not stopped growing. Both point the same way, and neither alone would be enough.
